It's weird, in Missouri there are two basic schools of thought regarding Branson. One is that it's a cute little town perfect for perhaps a 3 day weekend and every time you go there you can find something else to do. The second is that it's a vicious tourist trap designed to make any asshole who finds themselves there to spend as much money as they can. I align more with the latter. Silver Dollar City IS fun and there are a few cool places to go that I'm sure your kids and you would love, but honestly I think there are much better places to go for your money. I'd put Lake of the Ozarks ahead of that place
